title: Bounty
caption: Bounty (V)
game_text: Deploy on a just captured character without a bounty. During your control phase, may transfer captive to a related prison (take this card into hand) to retrieve 4 Force. If released, place captive (and cards on them) in owner’s Used Pile. Your Force drains are +1 here. {control}
lore: One of the most profitable occupations in the galaxy is hunting down and capturing wanted beings. The more notable the quarry, the more profitable the venture.

notes: Non-unique (no dot on heading/caption; printed card Unrestricted). Banner IMMEDIATE EFFECT with NO grabber box → grabber false; printed base is a Cloud City Effect. Red circle-slash C at the end → {control}. Curly apostrophe in owner’s. Margin credits one line each: left 'Original concept by Steven Lewis', right 'Tennessee States 2006'. The wiki's 'Bounty' page is itself the printed archive face (CC-D-bounty-decipher-archive.gif, 350 px, used as src); the 745 px CC-D-bounty.gif was downloaded to src/vs12/26-CC-D-bounty.gif for art only (likely the PC errata face — lore identical; copyright 'TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.' read off it). Lore matches the wiki. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2-D-bounty-pre.gif, 350 px).
